scope: Deterministic canonical-unit comparison views for all currently profiled armored vehicles while preserving original claims, qualifiers and sources.
notes: Original source values and units remain unchanged inside canonical entities.
The comparison layer is a deterministic derivative and can be rebuilt from canonical claims.
Multiple configurations remain multiple rows; the normalizer does not select a preferred variant.
Categorical and boolean claims remain visible but are excluded from numeric ranking.
Unknown numeric units fail the Batch 07 CI gate instead of being guessed.
